instruction: L-Shaped Studio Flat Shell Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to create a new metric IFC4 one-storey studio flat shell from a blank model. Save the completed model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. The project hierarchy must contain one project, one site, one building, and one storey named Studio Level at elevation 0.00 m. Model exactly three spaces, eight walls, two slabs, one door, four windows, five openings, five void relationships, and five fill relationships. Do not include proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique. Create IfcSpaces named Living, Bath, and Kitchenette. Living must have clear plan dimensions of 3.80 m by 6.00 m; Bath and Kitchenette must each be 3.00 m by 1.30 m; all three spaces must be 2.80 m high, and Living must have the larger area. Name the slabs Floor Slab and Roof Slab, make each 7.40 m by 6.40 m by 0.20 m, and align their XY extents. Use walls that are 3.00 m high and 0.20 m thick. The door must have OverallWidth 0.95 m and fill one wall opening; each window must have OverallWidth 1.20 m and fill one wall opening. Assign all spaces, walls, slabs, the door, and the windows to Studio Level. Other representation details may vary. [Software] Bonsai workflows are used together with Blender; start Blender with `blender` (adjust path if needed).
